SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
GEN. REGISTRY
File No: 405
S. 1. Special Branch. Station, 40
REPORT
Date: October 2, 1940.

Subject...Article in the Fairiku Shimpo containing allegations against
the Moore Memorial Church - editor interviewed.
Made by...J. S. Kumashita...Forwarded by...J. I. Crawford.

On the morning of October 2, 1940, in
accordance with instructions of J. C. (Special Branch),
the undersigned interviewed Mr. Kojima, deputy chief
editor of the "Fairiku Shimpo", 280 Seward Road, in
the absence of Mr. Fukuya, the chief editor, and
requested him to publish a correction of the article
which appeared in the issue dated September 20, 1940,
containing allegations to the effect that the Moore
Memorial Church had been utilized by Chungking elements
as their communication centre and also that on
September 10, 1940, a performance of an anti-Japanese
character had taken place in the church in question.
The attached letters from the Moore Memorial Church
and the Publicity Department of the British Embassy,
respectively, have been shown to Mr. Kojima.

Mr. Kojima stated that he also had received a
similar letter from the Moore Memorial Church, but
that before a correction could be published he must
make his own investigations as to whether or not the
report referred to above is correct. If the report
proves to be groundless, a corresponding correction
will be published.

J. Kumashita
J. S.

D. C. (Special Branch).

日期：1940年10月2日。

事由……《大陆新报》刊登针对慕尔堂（Moore Memorial Church）的指控——已采访该报编辑。
呈报人……J. S. Kumashita……转呈人……J. I. Crawford。

1940年10月2日上午，根据特别股 J. C. 的指示，本人在主编福屋先生缺席的情况下，采访了西华德路280号《大陆新报》副主编小岛先生，要求其对1940年9月20日刊出的文章进行更正。该文章含有如下指控：慕尔堂被重庆方面用作通讯中心，且于1940年9月10日在该教堂举行了具有反日性质的演出。本人已向小岛先生出示了随函附上的慕尔堂及英国大使馆新闻处的来信。

小岛先生表示，他也收到了慕尔堂的一封类似信件，但在刊登更正之前，他必须自行调查上述报道是否属实。如果证明该报道毫无根据，将刊登相应的更正声明。

J. Kumashita
J. S.

                              S.I. Special Br. statichl
              REPORT          Date October 1st 19 40.

Subject (in full) Allegations against the Moore Memorial Church

Made by D.I. Kao Yen Ken        Forwarded by D.I. Crawford

With reference to the article appearing in the
Tairiku Shimpo dated September 21 alleging that the
Moore Memorial Church Yu Ya Ching Road has been used as
an anti-Japanese base and held an anti-Japanese per-
formance on September 18, enquiries show that no
performances took place in the church on September 18.
    Routine visits are paid by Special Branch
personnel to the Church premises but no political
activities have been seen.

                              Kao Yen Ken
                                D.   I.

D.C. (Special Branch).

堂 爾 慕
Moore Memorial Church
METHODIST EPISCOPAL CHURCH, SOUTH
316 YU YA CHING ROAD
SHANGHAI

Sep. 25, 1940.

The Superintendent,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
Shanghai.

Dear Sir,

Our attention has been called to an item in the China
Press of Sep. 22nd and also in the "Sing Sung Pau" of
Sep. 21st reflecting on the work of this church.

We beg to state that the statements in the item are
entirely false. There was no "dramatic performance"
of any kind here on Sep. 18th, as stated in the paper.
As most people fully understand our church is carrying
on purely Christian service, and no political groups or
political meetings are permitted whatever.

We know that your Department is well acquainted with
these facts, but in view of the above press items, we
write this letter merely to assure you that our policy is
that of a Christian church and will continue to be the
same.

Thanking you, I am

Sincerely yours,
MOORE MEMORIAL CHURCH
by S. R. Anderson
S. R. Anderson

慕尔堂
Moore Memorial Church
美南监理会
上海虞洽卿路316号

1940年9月25日。

上海公共租界工部局警务处总监，
上海。

尊敬的先生：

我们注意到9月22日《字林西报》以及9月21日《新申日报》上有一则涉及本堂工作的报道。

我们要声明，该报道中的陈述完全失实。正如报纸所述，9月18日本堂并未举行任何形式的“戏剧演出”。正如大多数人所充分了解的，本堂仅开展纯粹的基督教礼拜活动，绝不允许任何政治团体或政治集会。

我们知道贵部门对这些事实非常熟悉，但鉴于上述报刊报道，我们致此信仅是为了向贵方保证，我们的方针是基督教会方针，并将继续保持不变。

此致
敬礼，

慕尔堂
由 S. R. Anderson 代签
S. R. Anderson

SRA:DC

CHINA PRESS.

SEP 27 1940

We, The People

THE CHINA PRESS welcomes the views of its readers on subjects of the day, but publication in the correspondence column does not mean necessarily that the views expressed by correspondents are those of THE CHINA PRESS.

False Report

Editor, THE CHINA PRESS.
Sir,—Our attention has been called to an item in your edition of Sept. 22, 1940 entitled, “Nippon Daily Bares Spy Ring in Moore Memorial Church.”
Each statement in the item is false, except the statement of your source of information. We have considered THE CHINA PRESS to be a paper with ethical standards, and do not understand why it should now print such a false report, apparently with no effort to investigate its truth or falsity.
We believe that it is well known in Shanghai that the Moore Memorial Church has been carrying on a purely service program among years, under the auspices of the American (Southern) Methodist Mission. None of its activities have ever been “suppressed,” because all recognize that they are for the good of the people. During the week Sept. 15-22, open evangelistic meetings were held, urging the people to repent of their sins and live the Christian life. (There was no “dramatic performance” of any kind on Sept. 18.)
Possibly such a false report slipped in unnoticed, so we call attention to it, believing that you desire to give a fair deal to purely service institutions.

Sincerely yours,
Moore Memorial Church by
S. R. ANDERSON.

Shanghai, Sept. 24, 1940.

The item referred to above is a translation of a Tairoku Shimbun report sent in by Domei. It appears that certain charges have been made by the Japanese journal, and we believe that suppression of the report would do more harm to the Moore Memorial Church, particularly when such report is incorrect, as claimed by the Church.—Ed.

（批：O.T. Kao. Please attach to your file. 9/27/9）
page_data.zh:
《字林西报》。

1940年9月27日

我们，人民

《字林西报》欢迎读者就当日话题发表观点，但来信栏的刊登并不必然意味着撰稿人所表达的观点代表《字林西报》的立场。

不实报道

《字林西报》编辑：
先生，——我们注意到贵报1940年9月22日版中题为“日本每日新闻揭露慕尔堂间谍网”的一则报道。
除消息来源的陈述外，该报道中的每一句话都是虚假的。我们一直认为《字林西报》是一家具有道德标准的报纸，不明白为何现在要刊登如此虚假的报道，显然未对其真伪进行任何调查努力。
我们相信，在上海众所周知的是，慕尔堂在美国（南方）监理会传教团的主持下，多年来一直开展纯粹的服务项目。其活动从未被“取缔”，因为所有人都认识到这些活动是为了民众的利益。在9月15日至22日这一周，举行了公开的布道会，呼吁人们忏悔罪过，过基督徒的生活。（9月18日没有任何形式的“戏剧演出”。）
也许这样虚假的报道在未被注意的情况下混入版面，因此我们提请注意，相信贵报希望给予纯粹的服务机构以公平对待。

此致
敬礼，
慕尔堂
由
S. R. ANDERSON 代签。

上海，1940年9月24日。

上述提及的报道是对同盟社发送的《大陆新报》报道的翻译。看来这家日本期刊提出了一些指控，我们认为，压制该报道会对慕尔堂造成更大伤害，尤其是当该报道如教堂所称是不正确的时候。——编者注。

（批注：O.T. Kao. 请附入你的档案。9/27/9）

Sin Shun Pao (Japanese-owned Chinese language newspaper) of
September 26 :-

LETTER FROM PUBLICITY DEPARTMENT OF BRITISH EMBASSY

To the Editorial Department :

The report published by your paper on
September 21 to the effect that the Moore Memorial
Church at No. 316 Yu Ya Ching Road is a British missionary
church is untrue.

The Moore Memorial Church was not
established by a British missionary sect nor has it any
connection with any British organization.

Hoping that a correction will be made.

The Publicity Department of the
British Embassy.
September 23.

9月26日《新申日报》（日资中文报纸）：

英国大使馆新闻处来信

致编辑部：

贵报9月21日刊登的报道称，位于虞洽卿路316号的慕尔堂是一家英国传教士教堂，此说法不属实。

慕尔堂并非由英国传教宗派建立，也与任何英国组织没有任何联系。

希望能予以更正。

英国大使馆
新闻处
9月23日。

September 21, 1940.
Morning Translation.

TAIRIKU SHIMPO
ANTI-JAPANESE CHURCH AND SCHOOL IN INTERNATIONAL
SETTLEMENT

The Moore Memorial Church (British) is located
at No.316 Yu Ya Ching Road near Hankow Road. This church
had been used by Chungking elements as a communications base
since the outbreak of the Sino-Japanese hostilities. Their
activities were suppressed by the S.M.P. On September 18,
the anniversary of the Mukden Incident, more than 300
Christians assembled at the church to attend an anti-
Japanese performance.

1940年9月21日。
晨间译文。

《大陆新报》
国际公共租界内的反日教堂和学校

慕尔堂（英国）位于靠近汉口路的虞洽卿路316号。自中日敌对行动爆发以来，该教堂一直被重庆方面用作通讯基地。他们的活动受到上海公共租界工部局警务处的压制。9月18日，即沈阳事变纪念日，300多名基督徒聚集在教堂参加了一场反日演出。
